entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned APP for the State.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioners seeks permission to withdraw the quashing application with respect to petitioner No. 03 (Soni Kumari).

4. Issue notice upon the Opposite Party No. 2 by both modes i.e. registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary post for which requisites etc., must be filed on or before 05.01.2024 failing which this application shall stand rejected without further reference to a Bench.
5. Put up this case on 04.03.2024.

1 6.

entities.text: Suresh Thakur And Ors vs State Of Bihar And Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the meantime, the order dated 08.03.2017 passed by the learned SDJM, Khagariya in complaint case No. 795C of 2016, whereby cognizance of offence under Sections 498A, 494 and 34 of the IPC read with Section 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act is taken, shall remain stayed.

7. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioners are father-in-law and mother-in-law of the O.P. No.
02.
It is next submitted that father-in-law is aged about 80 years and mother-in-law is aged about 77 years.
It is further submitted that whenever any dispute arises in between the husband and the wife the entire family members are implicated in a mechanical manner with general and omnibus allegations.

It is also submitted that O.P. No. 02 in the complaint has also alleged that her husband has performed his second marriage, it is thus submitted that even presuming what has been alleged is true then there is no allegation that the marriage of the husband, of the O.P. No. 02, was performed with the consent of the petitioners.

(Satyavrat Verma, J) Adnan/-
